title: Official resources
description: Start here for authoritative downloads, expansion information, development news, wiki documentation, mod distribution, and API references.

title: Reference, tutorials, and guides
description: Mechanics references, tutorials, cheat sheets, and community guides. Older guides are labeled when their game-version relevance is limited.

title: Calculators and production planners
description: Web, desktop, and in-game-adjacent tools for ratios, production chains, quality loops, power, balancers, and layout optimization.

title: Blueprint sites, editors, and libraries
description: Blueprint sharing sites, browser editors, string codecs, generators, and in-game blueprint utilities.

title: Circuit network programming and simulation
description: Compilers, IDEs, simulators, and display/control mods for building logic inside Factorio.

title: Art, music, maps, and visualization
description: Image-to-blueprint tools, MIDI music generators, map exporters, timelapse tools, and graphics resources.

title: Quality-of-life and information mods
description: Planners, recipe browsers, status displays, task lists, cursor tools, reach tools, and other interface improvements.

title: Logistics, trains, storage, and production mods
description: Train dispatchers, vehicles, drones, loaders, warehouses, and logistics infrastructure.

title: World, decoration, combat, and power mods
description: Terrain, biomes, decoration, visual effects, combat changes, and alternative power systems.

title: Overhauls and challenge modpacks
description: Large total conversions and challenge packs. Compatibility notes are especially important here; many overhauls are mutually exclusive.

title: Sandbox, testing, and editor tools
description: Creative/sandbox environments, editor extensions, mod test harnesses, coverage, and profiling tools.

title: Multiplayer, servers, and operations
description: Hosted services, Docker images, server managers, Clusterio, scenarios, RCON clients, monitoring, chat bridges, and deployment tooling.

title: Modding frameworks, data tooling, and developer utilities
description: API typings, Lua/Rust/TypeScript frameworks, data exporters, spritesheet tools, localization, packaging, and release automation.

title: Communities, discovery, and creators
description: Forums, Discords, subreddits, GitHub discovery feeds, speedrunning, community writing, and video creators.
